title: 10 Minutes Powerful Morning Prayer Before You Start Your Day
text: Father, we thank you. We thank you for breath. We thank you for life. We thank you for the mercy that kept us through the night. There are people who closed their eyes last night and never opened them again. But you preserved us. You kept us not because we are righteous, not because we are perfect, but because your mercy is relentless. Your mercy does not take a break. Your mercy does not sleep. And so this morning with everything within us, we say thank you. Thank you, Jehovah. Thank you El Shadai. Thank you Adonai Raboni Shalaba Core Shanday Raboni. We worship you in the spirit this morning. We worship you beyond the limitations of human language. The spirit himself makes intercession with groanings that cannot be uttered. And right now the spirit of the living God is moving. I can sense it. I can feel it. Something is shifting in the atmosphere even as you are listening to this. Now I want you to do something for me before we go any further. I want you to share this message with someone. Send the link right now. Don't wait until the end. There is someone connected to your destiny who needs to hear what God is about to release in this service. You might be the bridge between somebody and their breakthrough. You might be the reason someone's chains are broken today. The Bible says in Acts chapter 8 that Philip was sent to the Ethiopian uno and one encounter changed the trajectory of a nation. You could be Philillip to somebody this morning. Share this, post it, send it to that group. Send it to that family member who has been struggling. God wants to use you as a distribution center for miracles. Now settle in. I'm going somewhere this morning. The Lord gave me something and I want to share it with you before we enter into prayer. Because you see there is a way to pray that moves heaven and there is a way to pray that is mere religion. And my assignment this morning is to ensure that by the time we are done you will have crossed over from one realm into another. You will not live the same way you came. Something is going to happen in your spirit. Something is going to break in the realm of the spirit. And what God does next in your life will require explanation. Open your Bible with me to Psalm 5:es 1-3. The psalmist David wrote these words under the inspiration of the Holy Ghost. He said, "Give ear to my words, O Lord. Consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God. For unto thee will I pray. My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up. Did you see that? David said in the morning, not in the afternoon. Not when it is convenient. Not when you have exhausted all other options. In the morning, before the battle lines are drawn, before the enemy sets his agenda, before the world tries to dictate the terms of your day. In the morning, you rise and you take authority. In the morning, you open your mouth and you legislate in the realm of the spirit. Now, write this down. There is something about the morning that the spirit of God wants you to understand. The morning is not just a time. It is a spiritual gateway. It is a portal of authority. When God created the heavens and the earth in Genesis chapter 1, the Bible says, "And the evening and the morning were the first day." God counts time differently from man. The morning is the beginning of divine accounting. It is the first entry in the ledger of heaven for that day. And whoever dominates the morning dominates the day. Let me take you to another scripture. Look at Mark 1:35. [music] The Bible says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." This is Jesus Christ, the son of the living God, the one through whom all things were made, the alpha and the omega. And even he with all authority in heaven and on earth understood the protocol of the morning. He rose up a great while before day, not a small while, a great while before the disciples could find him. He had already been in the presence of the father. Before Peter, James, and John came looking for him, he had already settled the affairs of that day in the spirit. Listen carefully. If the son of God needed to pray in the morning, what makes you think you can survive your day without it? If Jesus, who had no sin, who needed no deliverance, who was not fighting generational curses, still prioritize the morning altar, how much more should you and I, who are contending with principalities and powers and rulers of the darkness of this world. There are dimensions to this that I want to unpack for you. You see, the morning is when the courts of heaven are most attentive. I am not saying God does not hear prayer at other times. Of course he does. The Bible says he neither slumbers nor sleeps in Psalm 121:4. But there is a principle in scripture that the morning carries a unique grace for decree. Job 38 12-13 says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the daypring to know his place that it might take hold of the ends of the earth that the wicked might be shaken out of it." Did you hear that? God asked Job, "Have you commanded the morning?" The morning is something you command. It is not something you stumble into. It is not something you yawn through. You command it. You take it by the horns. You speak into it. You release decrees into the morning. And those decrees take hold of the ends of the earth. And the wicked are shaken out of your day. The plans of the enemy, the traps that have been set, the ambush that has been arranged, the evil that has been programmed into your day when you command the morning, they are shaken out. Like dust from a garment, they fall off like chaff before the wind. They are scattered. Somebody needed to hear that. Now, the second thing I want you to see is this. Lamentations 3:es 22-23 says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." The mercies of God are new every morning. That means every morning is a fresh deposit. Every morning is a new account. Every morning God credits your spiritual account with mercy that is sufficient for that day. But here is the mystery. Mercy that is not accessed is mercy that is wasted. You must rise in the morning and withdraw from the account of heaven. You must rise and say, "Lord, I receive the fresh mercy that you have allocated for today. I receive the fresh grace. I receive the fresh anointing. I receive the fresh favor." This is why the enemy fights your morning. This is why you feel heavy when you try to pray early. This is why your alarm does not ring. This is why distractions come. Because the devil knows that if you ever get to the altar in the morning, his plans for your day are dismantled. He knows that a man or a woman who has commanded the morning is dangerous. You become untouchable. You become undefeable. You become a threat to the kingdom of darkness. Thus said the spirit of God, there is a recalibration that is happening in this season. The Lord is raising up a generation of morning warriors. Not people who casually pray. Not people who whisper a few words and rush out the door, but people who will rise with fire in their spirits and contend for their destinies before the sun rises. And if you are one of those people, if you are hearing this and something is burning within you, then you are one of them. You have been chosen for this. You have been marked for this. Let me show you something else that will change your life. Go with me to Isaiah 50:4. The Bible says, "The Lord God had given me the tongue of the land that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakenth morning by morning. He wakenth mine ear to hear as the learned." Look at that phrase. He wakenth morning by morning. God wakes you up. That alarm clock is not what woke you up this morning. That was God. The Holy Spirit himself stirred your spirit and said, "Rise, it is time. There are things to be done in the realm of the spirit and I need you at the altar. And then he says, he wakenth my ear to hear as the learned. When you show up in the morning, God does not just speak to you. He opens your ear. He fine-tunes your spiritual frequency. He gives you the tongue of the learned so that you know how to speak a word in season. Suddenly you know what to pray. Suddenly you know what to decree. Suddenly revelation begins to flow. Secrets are revealed. Strategies are downloaded. Wisdom that you did not learn in any school drops into your spirit like rain. Somebody say, "I receive it." Now, I want to make something very clear before we enter into prayer. You are not praying this morning because of religion. You are not praying because you are trying to earn the love of God. No, you are praying because you are a son. You are praying because you are a daughter. You are praying because you have legal authority in the realm of the spirit. And this morning you are going to exercise it. Romans 8:15 says, "For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you have received the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, abba, father." You cry, "Aba, father." Not as a slave, not as a servant begging for crumbs, but as a child who knows the father, as a child who has access, as a child who can walk boldly into the throne room and present their petitions with confidence. Hebrews 4:16 says, "Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." boldly, not timidly, not apologetically, boldly because the blood of Jesus has given you access. The cross of Calvary has turned the veil and now you can enter into the holiest of holies. Not once a year like the high priest, but every single morning, every single day. That is your birthright. That is your covenant privilege. And so this morning, you are going to pray like a king. You are going to decree like a priest. You are going to legislate like an ambassador of the kingdom of heaven. And every power, every spirit, every darkness, every agenda that has been arranged against your day, against your week, against your month, against your year, it is coming down. It is coming down now. I decree and I declare over your life before we even begin the full prayer that today is not ordinary. Today is not like yesterday. Today carries a prophetic distinction. Something is shifting. Something is turning. Something that has been closed is about to open. Something that has been delayed is about to be released. Something that has been stolen is about to be restored. I speak it by the authority of the word of God. I speak it by [music] the power of the blood of Jesus Christ. I speak it in the name that is above every name. The name of Jesus. The spirit of the living God is moving right now. I can sense it. Can you sense it? Now, lift your hands wherever you are. I don't care if you're in your room. I don't care if you're in your car. I don't care if you're on a bus. Lift your hands. This is your altar. This moment is your altar. And we're about to enter into a dimension of prayer that will restructure the spiritual architecture of your life. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before you this morning, not with the words of human wisdom, but with the demonstration of the spirit and of power. We come before you as your children. [music] We come before you as the redeemed of the Lord. We come before you as those who have been washed in the blood of the lamb. And we say, "Let your kingdom come. [music] Let your will be done in our lives, in our families, in our finances, in our health, in our marriages, in our careers, in our ministries. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. [music] I plead the blood of Jesus over every soul connected to this prayer right now. I plead the blood of Jesus over your mind. I plead the blood of Jesus over your body. I plead the blood of Jesus over your family. I plead the blood of Jesus over your home. I plead the blood of Jesus over your children. I plead the blood of Jesus over your finances. I plead the blood of Jesus over your going out and your coming in from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head. The blood of Jesus speaks and it speaks better things than the blood of Abel. It speaks mercy. It speaks protection. It speaks deliverance. It speaks healing. It speaks breakthrough. Now I want to pray specifically this morning. Stay with me. Don't lose focus. Don't let your mind wander. The enemy will try to distract you. He will bring thoughts. He will bring drowsiness. He will bring noise. Resist him. James 4:7 says, "Resist the devil. And he will flee from you." Resist that distraction now and lock into this prayer. Father, I bring before you this morning the matter of destiny. There are people under the sound of my voice whose destinies have been tampered with. The enemy came early. He came in their childhood. He came through family altars. He came through covenants that were made by their forefathers. He came through words that were spoken over them. He came through environments that were designed to limit them. And Lord, I am asking you this morning, reverse it. Reverse it now. Every spiritual padlock that [music] has been placed upon your destiny, I command it to break now in the name of Jesus. Every chain that has been tied around the purpose of God for your life, I command it to shatter now. Every cage in the realm of the spirit where your destiny has been kept in captivity, I command fire upon it now. Fire, fire, fire. Isaiah 61:1 says, "The spirit of the Lord God is upon me because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek. He had sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and the opening of the prison to them that are bound. I proclaim your liberty this morning. I proclaim the opening of your prison. Whatever has held you bound, it loses its grip now. Whatever has kept you stagnant, it releases you now. Whatever has delayed your progress, it is consumed by fire now. The spirit of God is breaking chains right now. I can see it. Somebody's chains are falling off right now. Someone under the sound of my voice, you have been battling a cycle, a cycle of failure, a cycle of near success. You get close and then it slips away. You almost have it and then it crumbles. The Lord is showing me that this is not natural. This is a spiritual pattern that was programmed into your bloodline. But I have a word for you. The cycle breaks today, not tomorrow, not next year, today. By the blood of Jesus and by the power of the Holy Ghost, that cycle is terminated. It will never repeat again. You are stepping out of the loop. You are entering into the straight path. Proverbs 4:18 says, "But the path of the just is as the shining light that shineth more and more unto the perfect day. Your path shines from today, it shines brighter and brighter. No more darkness on your path, no more confusion, no more dead ends. The Lord is clearing the way. [music] I speak to your finances this morning in the name of Jesus. I address every spirit of poverty, every spirit of lack, every spirit of financial embarrassment that has been assigned against your life. You are not permitted to operate any longer. Malachi 3:10 says, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house and prove me now herewith, said the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. I activate this promise over your life. I decree that financial doors that have been shut are swinging open now. Opportunities are being released. Contracts are being signed in the realm of the spirit. Transfers are being made. Resources are being redirected towards your life. The wealth of the sinner that has been stored up is being released to you the just. According to Proverbs 13:22, you will not beg, you will not borrow, you will lend to nations. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand, and thou shall lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow." I am speaking to somebody right now. The embargo on your finances is lifted. I don't know who you are, but the Lord is showing me a man. Your name starts with the letter D. David, Daniel, Damola, I don't know. But the Lord says the season of financial struggle is over. I am opening a new stream. I am opening a new river. Watch what I do in the next 72 hours. Receive it. If that is you, receive it by faith. And there is a woman, you have been praying about a business, you invested and it seemed like everything went wrong. The Lord says, I am turning it around. What looked like a failure was actually a setup for a testimony. [music] Watch me. I don't know where you are. You might be in London. You might be in Abuja. You might be in Houston. You might be in Johannesburg. But the Lord says your business is not dead. I am breathing upon it. I am resurrecting it and it will flourish beyond your imagination. Father, I pray for every financial gate that needs to open this morning. I pray for jobs. I pray for promotions. I pray for business breakthroughs. I pray for supernatural provision. I pray for debts to be cancelled. I pray for unexpected checks in the mail. I pray for divine connections that lead to financial increase. I pray according to Philippians chapter 4:1 19, my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Supply, Lord. supply now in Jesus' name. I am moving to another area and I want you to pray with intensity here because this is critical. I am talking about your health, your body, your physical well-being. There is someone listening to me right now and you have been battling with a condition in your body. The doctors have given you a name for it. They have given you medication. They have told you what to expect. But this morning I am coming with a higher report. Isaiah 53:5 says, "But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him. And with his stripes we are healed. With his stripes, not with medication alone, not with surgery alone. With his stripes, the stripes that were laid on the back of Jesus at the whipping post have already paid for your healing. It is a finished work and this morning I am calling it forth. I am calling your healing forth from the realm of the spirit into the realm of the physical. Every sickness, every disease, every infirmity, I speak to you now in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Cancer, you are not permitted. Diabetes, you lose your grip. High blood pressure, I command you to normalize now. fibroid shrivel up and die. Kidney disease be reversed now. Heart condition be healed now. I speak to every organ. I speak to every tissue. I speak to every cell. Be healed. Be restored. Be made whole by the power of the living God. Third John 1:2 says, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prosperth." It is the wish of God. It is the will of God. It is the desire of God that you walk in health and I release that health upon you now from the top of your head to the bottom of your feet. Let healing flow. Let restoration flow. Let divine health be your portion. Somebody, the Lord is showing me you have been having headaches, persistent recurring headaches that no scan has been able to explain. The Lord says it is a spiritual attack and I rebuke it now. I command it to seize now. By the stripes of Jesus, it is done. You will not have that headache again. It is finished. And there is someone else. There is a pain in your lower back. You have been carrying it for months, maybe years. The Lord says, "Lift your hands right now and begin to move your body. Begin to stretch. The healing virtue of the Lord is touching your spine right now. Receive it. Receive it. The pain is leaving. I can see it leaving right now in the name of Jesus. Y healing is flowing. Healing is flowing like a river this morning. Now I want to address the area of family because the enemy knows that if he can destroy the family, he can destroy the nation. If he can break the home, he can break the future. And so many of you, your families are under attack. There is division. There is strife. There is misunderstanding. Husband and wife are not on the same page. Children are going in the wrong direction. Siblings are fighting. Parents are estranged. But this morning, I am coming with the fire of restoration. Malachi 4:6 says, "And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse." I release the spirit of Elijah upon your family this morning. I command hearts to be turned. I command walls to be broken down. I command bridges to be built. I command reconciliation to happen. I command love to be restored. I command unity to prevail. Every evil altar that is speaking against your family, I command fire upon it now. Every ancestral covenant that is releasing division into your bloodline, I break it now by the blood of Jesus. Every demonic agent that has been assigned to scatter your family, I bind you now. I silence you now. I render you powerless now. Your family shall be preserved. Your family shall be united. Your family shall serve the Lord. Joshua 24:15 says, "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." Declare it right now wherever you are. Say it with your mouth. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. When you make that declaration, angels are dispatched to your household. Protection is released. Salvation is released. Every member of your family who is far from God, I decree a divine arrest upon their lives right now. Like Saul on the road to Damascus, the Lord will arrest them. They will encounter the light of the gospel. They will bow their knees. They will confess Jesus as Lord. Not one shall be missing. Not one shall be lost. I speak to marriages now. I speak to marriages now. Every marriage under the sound of my voice that is under attack, I release the peace of God upon that union. I release the love of God upon that home. I rebuke every spirit of divorce. I rebuke every spirit of infidelity. I rebuke every third party, every strange woman, every strange man that has been introduced into your marriage by the device of the enemy. I command them to be removed now. I command them to be cut off now. I command the hedge of protection around your marriage to be restored. Ecclesiastes 4:12 says, "A three-fold cord is not quickly broken." When God is at the center of your marriage, no devil can break it. And this morning, I reestablish God at the center of your home. I reestablish the altar of prayer in your house. I reestablish communication. I reestablish intimacy. I reestablish trust. What the enemy stole, I call it back. What the cankerworm ate, I decree restoration. And someone, you have been believing God for a life partner. You have been waiting and the wait has been long. The wait has been painful. You have watched others walk down the aisle and you have wondered, "When is it my turn?" The Lord says to you this morning, "Your season has come. I am connecting you. The one I have prepared for you is already in motion. I am aligning parts. I am orchestrating divine meetings. Do not give up. Do not settle. Do not compromise. [music] What I am bringing to you is worth the wait. I decree over every single person who is trusting God for a spouse before this year ends. You will testify the right person, the God- orained person, the covenant partner that heaven has chosen for you, they are coming. They are coming. I release them from the north, from the south, from the east, from the west. Every delay is broken. Every spiritual padlock on your marital destiny is shattered in the name of Jesus. Now lift your voice. Lift your voice high right now. I want you to begin to pray in the spirit. Begin to pray in tongues. Begin to release fire from your belly. The Bible says in John 7:es 38-39, he that believeth on me, as the scripture had said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water. Let those rivers flow. Now, let that fire burn. Now, I want to deal with something now. Covenants, causes, evil altars. Because some of you have done everything right. You have prayed, you have fasted, you have given, you have served. And yet there is a resistance. There is a blockage. There is an invisible ceiling that you keep hitting. And the reason is this. There are covenants in your bloodline that were made before you were born. There are dedications that were done when you were a child. There are altars in your family that are still speaking. And until those altars are silenced, until those covenants are broken, progress will be limited. But I have good news for you. So right now in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I address every evil covenant operating in your bloodline. Every covenant made with water spirits, I break you now.
